capability_bootstrap.note: SOH proposal to break A1-P2 early crown heat/rot vs cap_filter circularity: live roadside salvage + make_spares teaches cap_salvage; safe southern Amberwood apothecary first-visit grants cap_filter before exposed crown buffer. cap_salvage is also granted by the first safe roadside salvage claim so the filter bootstrap does not depend on crypt-bone make_spares.

dry wadi, no shade, salt crust
tidal channels, barnacle lines, drift wrack
gas bubbles, bleached reeds, still water
cenote depth, cold water, no surface exit

late_goals.text: Open the tier-3 customs vault with an abyssal pearl and a restored boat; the seal unlocks a new core family, not just a bigger chest.
Dive the Great Cenote after combining thermal, filter and climb preparation; map the subsurface conduit to the Ashwater resurgence.
Restore the buried pump station to change safe fen channels, then run a purification/venom-core loop that revalues bog iron and peat.
Anneal storm glass and power the Glasswind light to reveal tide-gated wrecks and a coastal shortcut.
Solve the living-wood root lift to reach the canopy temple and a venom-core specimen without a boss-only gate.

capability_grant_policy.note: A1 first-visit bootstrap grants are allowed only for sheltered early capability sources. Late capabilities require A1 material approval and A3/A0 sinks; unresolved/missing materials block the grant in this product model.
